GitRoll Vault recovery kit, version 1

Keep this somewhere safe and offline: printed, or on a drive in a drawer.
Anyone with this kit and a copy of the vault can open the vault. Without it,
a vault whose devices are all lost can't be opened by anyone.

vault-name: fixture
vault-id: c54ecd7c438290cb16fffdc73bcb5f0bd1c98e3e832bd10cb822b8d0780b3fb0
member-id: ykm3zdx7swh2zfvdtvtxm5lhr4
age-identity: AGE-SECRET-KEY-1YQRN2G096UHS7MG0XNQMCVVQUHKGJGYEY9N3YYV3HVG7PEJZJHJQJPRV5A
signing-key: OXjlBwYgvlu7/ICjTnaHxpHY3OeK42T6fu5/p7elJv0=

To use it on a new computer, with the Roll cloned there (or a backup file):
  gitroll vault recover fixture --kit <this file> [--from <backup file>]
